name: Agent Bridge
description: Forward chat /agent commands to an explicitly configured local provider adapter.

projectCwd.description: Absolute path to the project directory where the selected agent runs. Falls back to env OPENCLAW_AGENT_BRIDGE_CWD.

provider.description: Explicit provider adapter. Changing it never reuses another provider's private session id.

agentBin.description: Name or absolute path of the selected provider CLI. Defaults by provider.

model.description: Optional provider model id passed only through that provider's adapter.

reasoningEffort.description: Requested reasoning effort when supported by the selected adapter.

capabilityMode.description: Required capability mode. Codex and Gemini currently support one-shot only.

allowedTools.description: Comma-separated allow-list used only by adapters that support it.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms to wait for the selected provider before killing the process.

maxReplyChars.description: Truncate the reply to this many characters (Telegram has a 4096-char hard limit).
